verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Fivetran serves an llms.txt at fivetran.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured documentation summary. Doc pages are also served as .md URLs, and Fivetran ships AI coding-agent plugins with Connector SDK skills for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and Copilot CLI. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation describing or maintaining the llms.txt / markdown-docs offering, the root docs.md endpoint returns 404, and no independent hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: We provide AI coding agent plugins that add Connector SDK-specific skills to Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and GitHub Copilot CLI.
